# hallpass_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role or git access profile of a server by alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hallpass_role" "web1_inspect" {
  server_id = data.hallpass_server.web1.id
  alias     = "inspect"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Role alias.
- `server_id` (String) Server or git remote ID.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `remote_user` (String) Remote account.
